maps.title: Seat maps
maps.intro: Draw a venue's seating once and reuse it for every event there. An event takes its own copy, so changing a map later never affects tickets already sold.
maps.empty: No seat maps yet. Start one from an event's Venue page.

editor.title: Seat map
editor.name: Map name
editor.unsaved: You have changes that are not saved.
editor.nothingSelected: Select a section or the stage to edit it, or add one.
editor.label: Label
editor.canvas: Seat map drawing. Drag items to move them.
editor.moveHint: Drag to move, or type a position.

event.title: Reserved seating
event.none: This event does not have reserved seating. Tickets are sold by number.
event.needVenue: Choose a venue first: a seat map belongs to a venue.
event.attached: This event has its own copy of a seat map with {count} seats.
event.detachConfirm: Remove reserved seating from this event? Its seat-based ticket types are deleted too.
event.locked: The seat map can only be changed while the event is a draft with nothing sold.
event.pricesIntro: A ticket type sold by seat applies to one or more sections. A section can have several, for example Adult and Student.
event.noTypes: No prices yet. Seats cannot be bought until their section has one.
event.blockIntro: Click seats to take them off sale or put them back, for a sound desk or a broken seat. Sold and reserved seats cannot be changed.

picker.title: Choose your seats
picker.intro: Select seats on the map. Your seats are reserved for 10 minutes once you continue.
picker.max: You can choose up to {max} seats in one order.
picker.taken: Some of those seats were just taken. They have been removed from your selection.
picker.map: Seat map. Use the arrow keys to move between seats and Enter to select.
picker.listNone: No seats available in this section.
picker.unpricedSection: Seats in this section are not on sale.
